svg.title: A video on every face
svg.text: Short looping clips play on the faces and keep swapping, one face at a time.
17 clips are shuffled like a deck of cards.
The three faces read the same deck, a third of the way apart,
so two faces never show the same clip at once.
After a full pass the deck is re-dealt, so the order never repeats.
Every 8 seconds the faces change: ceiling first, then each wall
1.5 seconds later, so the cube “turns over” face by face.
